values: Baseline target: 300 hours. Estimate assumes the iOS application has not been built yet.
Xcode project, environments, dependency setup, configuration, signing baseline and app structure.
App state, domain models, service/repository boundaries, shared errors and dependency injection.
Keycloak login, Keychain storage, session expiry/refresh, /auth/me, logout and regio resolution.
Reusable API client, request/response handling, DTOs, model mappers and authenticated calls.
Fetch regional plans, list/select/open flow, download required data and create active session.
Import, validate, store and load offline tile packages; missing/corrupt/storage handling.
ArcGIS map, points, lines, polygons, symbols, selection, locked layers and map interactions.
Shared point/geometry form, notes, statuses, item colors, open-item workflow and list/map synchronization.
Autosave, active-session JSON, finished plans, atomic writes, restart/crash recovery and safe cleanup.
CoreLocation permissions, current position, speed/altitude/course, red path and local track storage.
Camera, photo library/files, local originals/thumbnails, point/geometry attachment and safe retention.
Start/pause/resume timer, persisted timer state, essential action logging and logs payload.
Afronden/Verstuur, finished local plan, ArcGIS photo upload, plan/log uploads, retry and duplicate protection.
Logout, pending uploads, storage/map status, permission errors and safe destructive confirmations.
Monthly server job, version manifest, app update check, background download, validation, safe swap and rollback.
Unit/integration/UI tests, real iPad, offline/crash/auth/upload cases, fixes, archive and TestFlight release.

values: Automatic TPK / Operational Layers Update — 35 Hours
Recommended design: server-side monthly generation and publishing; iOS checks, downloads, validates and swaps safely.
Package/layer ownership, region strategy, version rules and update lifecycle.
Scheduled server script/job that generates or publishes the new package/layer release.
Version, publish date, URL, size, SHA-256, minimum app version and region metadata.
Check on launch/network return/manual refresh; compare installed and available versions.
Background URLSession, progress, space checks, temporary file and resumable behavior.
Verify integrity and ArcGIS load, avoid active-flight replacement, preserve last-known-good version.
Interrupted download, invalid manifest/package, low storage, offline mode and monthly rerun testing.
